disclaimer: Documentation-derived risk conditions; not a migration plan.
summary: Django 3.2 -> 4.2 crosses 3 release(s) (4.0, 4.1, 4.2). 151 risk paths: 7 critical, 47 high, 53 medium, 44 low. Main risk types: removed_api (60), changed_behavior (60), dependency_requirement (20). Critical: Python runtime older than 3.8 unsupported by Django 4.2; PostgreSQL 9.6 no longer supported; MariaDB 10.2 no longer supported; PostgreSQL 11 database no longer supported in Django 4.2; SQLite minimum version raised to 3.21.0. 126 context facts and 1 disqualified candidates are listed separately. Documentation-derived risk conditions; not a migration plan.

As a consequence, RawSQL() aggregations are no longer supported on MySQL, because Django cannot determine whether such aggregations are needed or valid in the GROUP BY clause. Applications using RawSQL() in aggregations on MySQL must switch to aggregation functions.

conditions.statement: The application runs against a MySQL database backend.
